title: 3rd Stopping Place 2nd Truth From The Comprehensiveness Of Mercifulness To Unity And Oneness

questions.question: In the sun example, what makes a person understand that the sun is one?
questions.answer: Its light reaches everything that faces it, showing one sun lighting many things.

questions.question: What do bright and clear objects show in the comparison?
questions.answer: They show signs of the sun by reflecting its light, warmth, and colors.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by saying the sun’s reflection appears even in tiny drops of water?
questions.answer: It teaches that one source can show its signs in many small places at the same time.

questions.question: In this passage, what does the sun stand for in the comparison?
questions.answer: It stands for Allah’s mercy and the truth that He is One.

questions.question: How does all-embracing mercy point to Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: Because one mercy reaches all things, it shows one Lord is caring for them all.

questions.question: What does the passage say about partners being joined with Allah?
questions.answer: It says His mercy shows that He has no partner at all.

questions.question: Where are signs of Allah’s Names especially seen, according to the passage?
questions.answer: In everything, especially in living beings, and most especially in human beings.

questions.question: What special quality does life give to an individual in this passage?
questions.answer: It gives a wide connection so the individual relates to the whole universe.

questions.question: How does that wide connection support the idea of oneness?
questions.answer: It shows one Lord makes each living thing linked to the rest of creation.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying He does all things in all things?
questions.answer: It means His action and care appear everywhere in creation.

questions.question: How is Allah’s glory shown in the whole universe in this section?
questions.answer: It is shown through mercy that reaches everywhere in a unified way.

questions.question: What does Allah gather into each living member of a species?
questions.answer: Samples of His many gifts and blessings.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah does for each individual while still keeping the universe whole?
questions.answer: He gives special care to each one without harming the order of everything else.

questions.question: Why is man given special attention in this passage?
questions.answer: Because many kinds of divine gifts are gathered in a concentrated way in human beings.

questions.question: What lesson comes from the example of the melon and its seed?
questions.answer: The one who makes the whole fruit is also the one who makes the seed.

questions.question: Why would it be impossible for a different maker to produce the seed?
questions.answer: Because the seed is tied to the fruit’s design, measure, and wisdom, so the same maker must make both.

questions.question: In the final comparison, what is the cosmos like, what is the earth like, and what is man like?
questions.answer: The cosmos is like a tree or garden, the earth is like a fruit or melon, and man is like a seed.

questions.question: What final conclusion does the passage reach from that comparison?
questions.answer: The One who creates even the smallest living being must also be the Creator and Sustainer of the whole earth and the whole universe.

questions.question: What is the main comparison at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: The passage compares the sun spreading light everywhere to mercy reaching all creation.

questions.question: Why is sunlight called a sign of unity in the example?
questions.answer: Because one light covers many things at once.

questions.question: What happens in the example when shiny things receive sunlight?
questions.answer: They reflect signs of the sun back to the viewer.

questions.question: What does seeing sunlight in many places lead a person to conclude?
questions.answer: That the sun is one and unique.

questions.question: What idea is added by saying the sun is close to all things through reflections?
questions.answer: It shows that one source can be present by its effects in many places.

questions.question: How is Allah’s mercy similar to that sunlight?
questions.answer: It surrounds and reaches all things.

questions.question: What truth does this wide-reaching mercy prove?
questions.answer: It proves Allah’s unity and that He has no partner.

questions.question: Besides mercy itself, what else is found in everything under that mercy?
questions.answer: Signs of many divine Names and a kind of manifestation from Allah.

questions.question: In which part of creation is this seen most clearly?
questions.answer: In living beings, and especially in human beings.

questions.question: What does life cause a person to do, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It makes the person connected to and concerned with the whole universe.

questions.question: Why does being related to the whole universe point to one Creator?
questions.answer: Because such a wide connection needs one Lord who controls everything together.

questions.question: What two ideas about Allah are proven by this?
questions.answer: That He is One and that He is active with all things.

questions.question: How does Allah show majesty throughout the universe in this section?
questions.answer: He shows it by mercy that is broad, ordered, and reaches all creation.

questions.question: What is meant by gathering samples of bounties in each living member of a species?
questions.answer: Each living thing carries signs of many blessings from Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the tools and organs of living beings?
questions.answer: They are arranged in an ordered way by Allah.

questions.question: What does Allah announce to each individual through this careful care?
questions.answer: His special kindness and attention to that individual.

questions.question: How does the passage describe man among created beings?
questions.answer: As the place where many kinds of divine gifts are brought together in a concentrated form.

questions.question: How does the melon and seed example support the argument of the passage?
questions.answer: It shows that the maker of a small part must be the maker of the whole.

questions.question: What roles do the cosmos, earth, and man play in the final comparison?
questions.answer: The cosmos is the large living system, the earth is like its fruit, and man is like the seed inside it.

questions.question: What belief should a reader reach at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: That the Creator of the tiniest living creature is also the Creator and Sustainer of everything.

questions.question: Which natural object is used first to help explain a religious truth?
questions.answer: The sun.

questions.question: What features of the sun are mentioned in the comparison?
questions.answer: Its light, heat, and colors.

questions.question: Why are mirrors, shiny things, and water drops important in the example?
questions.answer: They show how one sun can appear by its effects in many places.

questions.question: What does this example teach about unity before speaking about mercy?
questions.answer: One source can cover many things without becoming many sources.

questions.question: When the passage turns from the sun to mercy, what is being compared?
questions.answer: Sunlight spreading everywhere is compared to Allah’s mercy reaching everything.

questions.question: What does mercy covering all things show about Allah?
questions.answer: It shows He is One and unmatched.

questions.question: What does the passage say can be found in everything, especially living things?
questions.answer: Traces of divine Names and signs of Allah’s presence and action.

questions.question: Why are human beings mentioned separately from other living things?
questions.answer: Because these signs and gifts appear in a stronger and fuller way in people.

questions.question: What broad ability comes from life in this passage?
questions.answer: Life gives a being a kind of all-around connection with the universe.

questions.question: How is this connection a proof rather than just an interesting fact?
questions.answer: It points to one Lord who made all things work together.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah shows across the whole universe and earth?
questions.answer: The greatness and beauty of His glory through mercy.

questions.question: How does Allah treat each individual while also caring for the whole?
questions.answer: He gives each one personal care without disturbing the order of creation.

questions.question: What is one way the passage describes Allah’s care for living beings?
questions.answer: He organizes their parts and abilities in a wise way.

questions.question: What is special about man in relation to Allah’s blessings?
questions.answer: Many different blessings are gathered in a focused way in human beings.

questions.question: In the fruit example, why must the maker of the seed also be the maker of the melon?
questions.answer: Because the seed contains the plan and meaning of the fruit.

questions.question: What role do knowledge and wisdom play in drawing out the seed?
questions.answer: They show the seed is made with exact measure and purposeful design.

questions.question: What would be wrong with saying one being made the melon and another made the seed?
questions.answer: It would break the unity and order between the whole and its part.

questions.question: How does the passage use the tree or garden image for the cosmos?
questions.answer: It presents the universe as one organized whole full of life and growth.

questions.question: Why is the earth compared to a fruit or melon?
questions.answer: Because it is like a produced result within that larger whole.

questions.question: Why is man compared to a seed?
questions.answer: Because man carries concentrated meanings and signs, like a seed carrying the plan of a fruit.

questions.question: What final claim ties all the examples together?
questions.answer: The One who creates the smallest living creature must be the Lord of the whole universe.

questions.question: What does the passage use the sun to help us understand?
questions.answer: How one source can reach many things and still remain one.

questions.question: If many objects reflect the same sunlight, what does that tell us?
questions.answer: They all depend on one sun, not many suns.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention warmth and color along with light?
questions.answer: To show that several qualities from one source appear in many places.

questions.question: What deeper truth is the sun example preparing the reader to understand?
questions.answer: That Allah’s mercy and care reach all creation from one Lord.

questions.question: What proves Allah’s unity in the section about mercy?
questions.answer: His mercy surrounds and nourishes everything.

questions.question: How strongly does the passage reject the idea of any partner with Allah?
questions.answer: It rejects it completely.

questions.question: What appears in all things under the covering of mercy?
questions.answer: Signs of many divine Names and a kind of manifestation from Allah.

questions.question: Which created beings are highlighted most in this discussion?
questions.answer: Living beings, especially human beings.

questions.question: What does the passage say life gives to each individual?
questions.answer: A broad capacity to face and relate to the whole universe.

questions.question: Why is that broad capacity important for understanding tawhid?
questions.answer: Because it points to one Creator who manages all connections.

questions.question: What does Allah display through the mercy spread across the universe?
questions.answer: The greatness of His glory.

questions.question: What does Allah place in every member of living species?
questions.answer: Examples of His blessings.

questions.question: What does the ordering of tools and organs in living beings show?
questions.answer: Wise planning and special care.

questions.question: How can Allah care for each individual without damaging the order of the whole?
questions.answer: Because His power and wisdom are complete and unlimited.

questions.question: In what way is man a concentrated form of divine bounty?
questions.answer: Many kinds of blessings are combined in human beings.

questions.question: What everyday object is used to make this idea easier to picture?
questions.answer: A melon and its seed.

questions.question: What is the seed’s relationship to the melon in the example?
questions.answer: The seed is like a concentrated summary of the melon.

questions.question: Why must the same craftsman make both the fruit and the seed?
questions.answer: Because both belong to one design and one measured plan.

questions.question: How does the final comparison arrange the levels of creation?
questions.answer: Universe as a tree or garden, earth as fruit, and man as seed.

questions.question: What conclusion about the smallest living creature does the passage draw?
questions.answer: Its Creator must also be the Creator and Sustainer of the earth and the whole cosmos.

questions.question: What lesson about unity comes from the sun shining on everything facing it?
questions.answer: One thing can affect many things at once while remaining one.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention clear and polished objects?
questions.answer: Because they show the sun’s effects in a visible way.

questions.question: What is the point of saying the sun seems near to every mirrorlike thing?
questions.answer: It helps explain how one source can be close by its signs to many places.

questions.question: After the sun example, what divine quality becomes the main focus?
questions.answer: Mercy.

questions.question: How does mercy function like light in this passage?
questions.answer: It spreads widely and reaches all things.

questions.question: What belief about Allah is supported by mercy reaching all things?
questions.answer: That He is One and has no partner.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is found especially in living creatures?
questions.answer: Manifestations of Allah’s Names and signs of His nearness in action.

questions.question: Why are people given special mention?
questions.answer: Because these meanings appear most fully in human beings.

questions.question: What does life cause in a person besides just being alive?
questions.answer: It gives the person a link to the larger universe.

questions.question: What can we infer from a person being linked to the whole universe?
questions.answer: Human life is designed by the One who controls everything.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah shows through mercy across the cosmos and the earth?
questions.answer: The brilliance and greatness of His glory.

questions.question: How does Allah treat members of living species?
questions.answer: He places many blessings in them and arranges their abilities carefully.

questions.question: What does this careful arranging say about Allah’s relationship to individuals?
questions.answer: He gives each one special care and attention.

questions.question: How can every individual receive care without the universe falling into disorder?
questions.answer: Because Allah’s rule covers both the whole and each part perfectly.

questions.question: What does it mean that man contains many forms of bounty in a concentrated way?
questions.answer: Humans gather many blessings and signs within themselves.

questions.question: How does the seed example help explain concentrated bounty?
questions.answer: A seed holds a summary of the fruit in a compact form.

questions.question: What does the example teach about who can make the seed?
questions.answer: Only the maker of the whole fruit can truly make the seed.

questions.question: Why is another maker impossible in that example?
questions.answer: Because the seed depends on the fruit’s complete design, balance, and purpose.

questions.question: What three-part comparison is made near the end of the passage?
questions.answer: Universe to a tree or garden, earth to a fruit, and man to a seed.

questions.question: What is the strongest conclusion of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The Lord who creates even the smallest living being is the Lord of the entire cosmos.

questions.question: Which example from nature opens this passage?
questions.answer: The example of the sun and its light.

questions.question: What does the spread of sunlight help symbolize?
questions.answer: Unity.

questions.question: How do reflections help a person recognize one sun?
questions.answer: They show the same source through many reflected signs.

questions.question: What does the example suggest when even tiny water drops reflect the sun?
questions.answer: Great realities can show their signs in very small places.

questions.question: In the religious meaning of the comparison, what takes the place of sunlight?
questions.answer: The mercy of Allah.

questions.question: What does mercy reaching all things prove first?
questions.answer: Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What else does it prove about Allah besides unity?
questions.answer: That He has no partner and is present with all things by His action and care.

questions.question: What is seen in everything under the covering of mercy?
questions.answer: Signs of many divine Names and a sort of manifestation from Allah.

questions.question: In which beings are these signs especially noticeable?
questions.answer: In living things, especially human beings.

questions.question: What does life give to each individual according to the passage?
questions.answer: A wide-ranging relation to the whole universe.

questions.question: How does this relation become evidence for tawhid?
questions.answer: It shows one Creator connects the individual with all creation.

questions.question: What does Allah show in the whole cosmos through the breadth of His mercy?
questions.answer: The splendor of His glory.

questions.question: What does Allah gather into each member of animate species?
questions.answer: Samples of all kinds of blessings.

questions.question: What additional act of care does Allah show toward living beings?
questions.answer: He arranges their tools and organs with order and purpose.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah proclaims to each individual through this care?
questions.answer: His special kindness and beauty directed to that person or creature.

questions.question: How is man described in relation to divine gifts?
questions.answer: As a being in whom many blessings are brought together in a concentrated form.

questions.question: What simple object is used to illustrate concentration into a small form?
questions.answer: A seed inside a melon.

questions.question: How does the melon-seed example support the unity of the Creator?
questions.answer: It shows the one who makes the whole also makes the part that contains its plan.

questions.question: What larger comparison is built from this example?
questions.answer: The universe is like a tree or garden, the earth like its fruit, and man like the seed.

questions.question: What final conclusion should a student draw from all these comparisons?
questions.answer: The Creator and Sustainer of the smallest living being must also be the Creator and Sustainer of the earth and the whole universe.
